note: Data sourced from the official HKU Campus Services Office Catering directory (https://catering.hku.hk/en/eateries/) on 2026-11-15. Venue names, locations, hours, food offerings and service modes are transcribed from official outlet pages. Individual menu items are representative of each outlet's stated food offerings; prices are approximate and not officially verified (verified: false). Where an official page explicitly states a dietary certification (e.g. BIJAS = halal-certified vegetarian), that is reflected in the diets and menu tags.
